business_scope.primary_industry_name: Mobile Utility Software and Device Performance Optimization Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national corporate registry; no sub-state tax or registry distinctions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: U.S.-derived common law (Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law and ABA Model Business Corporation Act) overlaid with Marshallese customary law; corporate and commercial matters follow U.S. statutory jurisprudence
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Convention between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income (US-RMI DTAA, in force 2004)
Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (economic provisions, including certain tax and trade privileges)
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention, in force for RMI since 18 December 2015)
RMI maintains no substantial standalone bilateral investment treaty portfolio and is not a WTO member; investment protection is primarily contractual and constitutional

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2013 (as amended); Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), including name, registered-agent, and record-keeping provisions; Criminal Code (as amended) money-laundering and financing-of-terrorism offences; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) regulations and guidance; Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual-evaluation standards and FATF Recommendations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified or notarized copy of passport (biographical page) of each UBO and each director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the UBO's/director's home jurisdiction; notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the home jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention state; otherwise Consular Legalization through an RMI embassy/consulate or authorized consular channel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential or registered business address (utility bill or regulated bank statement) of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated bank in the UBO's home jurisdiction; notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable to the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (POA) appointing the licensed RMI registered agent and corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each UBO and/or proposed director in notarized form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate due-diligence package of any corporate shareholder: certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, and registry extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory adverse-media, PEP, and sanctions screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and any RMI FIU national list; full screen at onboarding and refresh at least annually. Foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates require senior-management-approved enhanced due diligence and ongoing transaction monitoring under Part III of the 2013 AML/CFT Act. Negative-news screening and risk-based EDD apply; all KYC records retained for at least five years after the end of the business relationship. Separately, if the RMI entity later registers to do business in a U.S. state, FinCEN beneficial-ownership reporting under the U.S. Corporate Transparency Act may apply.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General (single national registry); name clearance is filed through licensed RMI registered agents using the Registrar's official lodgment interface; no direct public self-service e-filing portal exists
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in English/Latin (Roman) script; there is no statutory transliteration doctrine, but diacritical marks are normalized to Latin equivalents; the name must be distinguishable from all existing registered and reserved names and must not misstate the corporate purpose (BCA Section 19)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The licensed registered agent lodges the name reservation with the Registrar; a cleared reservation is valid for 180 days, with no statutory extension, though an identical re-reservation may be filed upon expiry if still available. On rejection, the Registrar issues a refusal notice identifying the conflicting token or non-distinguishable name; the applicant may (i) file an administrative request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 30 days of the refusal notice, providing distinguishability arguments, or (ii) submit a revised name variant. If administrative reconsideration is denied, judicial review lies to the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the RMI Administrative Procedure Act within 60 days. In practice, refiling with a distinctive prefix or suffix is faster and more cost-effective than appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for general corporate compliance: the BCA requires only a registered office and a licensed registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent's professional address may serve as the registered office; no physical local office, employees, or equipment are statutorily required for a non-resident Business Corporation. However, under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations (2019), if the company is treated as carrying on an 'Intellectual Property Business' or 'Distribution and Service Centre' activity involving connected foreign parties (relevant to an app monetizing software/IP), it must satisfy economic substance tests requiring RMI management, employees, expenditure, and physical assets. Freemium app-store sales directly to end users are generally treated as ordinary active business income rather than passive IP exploitation where the entity does not merely hold or license IP for an affiliate; a licensing or cost-sharing structure should be reviewed at incorporation to avoid creating a substance obligation that cannot be physically satisfied in the RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated <5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk, non-resident standard entity; the Registrar may inspect only for cause under the BCA, and the FIU may conduct scheduled supervisory visits under the AML/CFT Act. The registered agent must respond to all regulatory correspondence within prescribed timelines.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (BCA fee schedule, based on authorized share capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year annual franchise/government maintenance fee prepaid at incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (annual franchise fee schedule; estimate for US$50,000 authorized capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed RMI registered agent and registered office retainer (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent (corporate service provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC/AML file compilation: UBO verification, PEP and OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and corporate beneficiary structure chart
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider / RMI compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and (if applicable) consular legalization of the four-document bundle (passport, address proof, POA, corporate pack)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-jurisdiction notary public and apostille competent authority (e.g., state Secretary of State or Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Articles of Incorporation, By-laws, initial shareholder and director consents, and POA documents
International courier, apostille transmission, and regulatory coordination

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Marshall Islands, Title 27, Chapter 2 of the Revised Code of the Marshall Islands (including provisions governing articles of incorporation, registered agents, directors, and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro; filings normally submitted through licensed registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (filed through a licensed registered agent).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum authorized or paid-up capital; shares may be issued for such consideration as the board determines; no escrow account requirement applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the share subscriptions identified in the Articles of Incorporation are accepted and the specified shares are issued immediately upon receipt of the agreed consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation is adopted as the office of [Registered Agent Name], located at [Street Address, Majuro], and the registered agent is appointed to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director A] and [Director B] are elected as the first directors to serve until the next annual shareholders’ meeting. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the Board appoints [Officer A] as Chief Executive Officer, [Officer B] as Secretary, and [Officer C] as Treasurer, each with the duties provided in the Bylaws, and all incorporation and formation actions are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a corporate name availability check to a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; reserve the name with the Registrar if desired and confirm the agent’s address as the statutory registered office; obtain a signed consent to act as registered agent.
required_dossiers: Consent and appointment of registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar to an existing registration, re-submit with a distinct alternative name and pay the next applicable reservation fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and Legal Counsel (with subsequent filing to Registrar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and sign the Articles of Incorporation, stating corporate name, authorized share structure, purpose, registered office and agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and any optional limitations. Notarize signatures where required by the registered agent’s internal policy.
required_dossiers: Statement of number of shares authorized
Registered agent consent and initial registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the Articles in accordance with Business Corporations Act formatting rules and obtain fresh signatures before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles via the registered agent, pay the state filing fee, and request a stamped duplicate showing the date of filing and the assigned corporate registration number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any deficiency letter within fifteen days; correct facts and refile amended Articles; if rejected, appeal to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the official Certificate of Incorporation from the Registrar, verify the corporate name, jurisdiction, commencement date, and corporate number, and file the certificate in the corporate minute book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error, submit a written application for administrative correction under the Business Corporations Act, attaching the certified filing evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Initial Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (by written consent or telephonic meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, approve the issuance of shares, appoint directors and officers, adopt the Bylaws, designate the registered office, and execute minutes or unanimous written consents for the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure any procedural omission by obtaining unanimous shareholder or board written consent; ensure any required notices of directors and officers are filed with the Registrar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None — no industrial manufacturing or processing operation is incorporated in the business scope; therefore no industrial licensing board is implicated.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial operating license is required for a non-resident mobile utility application enterprise.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / No EIA required — the business is digital and non-physical, with no construction or discharge activity in the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste thresholds are applicable at formation; if an office is later established, the operation must comply with RMI Environmental Protection Act standards and municipal waste collection rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a non-resident software entity without local premises; should a physical office be opened, fire safety certification and occupational health inspection must be secured from the Majuro Fire Department and the relevant Marshall Islands health authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); corporate registration administered by the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General; official government portal: gov.rm (RMIGOV).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign persons incorporate a non-resident Business Corporation under the RMI Business Corporations Act (Title 53) through a licensed registered agent. No RMI tax identification number or Business Privilege Tax (BPT) certificate is required for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation that derives no gross revenue from business conducted within the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Only if RMI-source gross revenue exceeds the USD 10,000 annual exemption must the corporation register with the Revenue and Taxation Division, obtain a BPT account, and file quarterly BPT returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (Business Corporation Act Section 104; Business Privilege Tax Act Section 209). Exempt from Business Privilege Tax, and RMI levies no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. Territorial scope: only business transacted within the Republic of the Marshall Islands could attract BPT; offshore app-store revenue is outside RMI nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No income tax code exists, so there are no check-the-box, partnership, or hybrid-mismatch elections. The only operative statutory election is the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status declaration: an annual sworn statement that no shares are beneficially owned by RMI residents or citizens and that no business is transacted within RMI. A corporation that ceases to satisfy either condition becomes electively taxable as a resident BPT taxpayer at a 3% gross-receipts rate.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales tax. The sole turnover-based levy is the Business Privilege Tax (a direct gross-receipts tax imposed at source), which does not apply to Non-Resident Domestic Corporations and is not an indirect or consumption tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD 10,000 annual gross revenue from business transacted within RMI is the BPT exemption and registration threshold; the non-resident corporation is outside BPT entirely regardless of worldwide revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, real-time tax API, or digital stamping mandate. Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console sales reports, together with payment-processor settlement statements, constitute the sole commercial documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: with no VAT/GST regime, there is no export zero-rating or input-credit refund mechanism. Offshore digital sales of the mobile utility app via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing create no RMI tax nexus, and the non-resident corporation's revenue stream is simply outside RMI taxation under a territorial non-filing position.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Corporations
Sworn Non-Resident Domestic Corporation declaration (Business Privilege Tax Act Section 209)
App Store Connect and Google Play Console sales and earnings reports
Apple IAP / Google Play Billing payment-processor settlement statements
Bank statements evidencing receipt of offshore settlement remittances in USD
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Business Privilege Tax Act 2012 (as amended), a false non-resident claim or under-reported RMI-source gross revenue subjects the corporation to reassessment at 3%, a late-filing penalty of 10% per month (capped at 100% of tax due), interest, accuracy-related penalties, and, in cases of fraudulent declaration, criminal fines and revocation of the non-resident exemption. No VAT clawback regime exists because no VAT is levied; no foreign-exchange repatriation deadline applies because the USD is the RMI legal tender and no exchange controls are imposed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No independent central bank in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); the U.S. dollar is sole legal tender. The Banking Commissioner, operating under the Financial Institutions Act 2017 and the Banking Act within the Ministry of Finance, exercises prudential banking supervision. No separate foreign-exchange administration or reserve-management authority exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility exists because the RMI is dollarized and has no domestic currency. Both current-account items (profits, dividends, royalties, service fees) and capital-account items (equity injections, liquidation proceeds) are freely convertible and remittable without exchange-control approval. Profit remittance from a Non-Resident Business Corporation is tax-exempt under Section 173 of the Business Corporations Act provided no income is sourced in the RMI. Practical impediments are limited to commercial-bank due diligence, correspondent-bank de-risking, and OFAC screening, not statutory currency controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. The RMI imposes no surrender obligations, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no statutory timelines for export proceeds. Digital app store proceeds may be retained indefinitely in U.S. dollars in any designated account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
USD Operational Account only (escrow facilities generally not offered)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for transaction settlement, Low for capital escrow and regulated deposit-taking. The RMI has no EMI licensing framework or passporting regime; an offshore EMI authorised in a recognised jurisdiction (e.g., FCA, EBA-licensed) may onboard the non-resident entity as a payment-services customer, but cannot maintain a local branch, hold RMI escrow capital, or represent itself as a bank in the RMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are not statutorily required to appear physically under RMI AML/CFT rules, but in practice Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam expect either an in-branch meeting with a local introducer or a high-assurance video KYC interview using biometric liveness and independent electronic identity verification. Remote opening is possible on a discretionary basis when the entity provides a reference from a tier-1 foreign bank and all UBO documentation is notarised and apostilled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-Resident Business Corporation with RMI tax-exempt status and no domestic taxable nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Corporate Charter locating the entity as non-resident, Board Resolution confirming no income sourced in RMI, Section 173 Tax-Exempt Declaration, detailed group structure chart, UBO register, source-of-wealth statement, three years of audited local financial statements if available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero physical substance and absence of local employees or premises
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent and registered-office agreements, professional advisory contracts, detailed mobile-application operating plan, Apple and Google developer account console screenshots, domain and hosting certificates, app-store revenue reports, and audited financial statements evidencing genuine digital operations outside the RMI.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency low-value inbound receipts from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing deemed indicative of layering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple Developer Program Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement, transaction-flow diagram, app privacy policy, end-user licence agreement, SDK and payment-processor contracts, financial-crime compliance manual, and an independent audit opinion on transaction monitoring.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity capital via SWIFT MT103/202 to the entity's USD account at a correspondent-confirmed bank, tagged with remittance narrative 'EQUITY CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION – MH_BC – DEAL#[date]'. No RMI central-bank purpose code is prescribed; use IMF BPM6 category 'Equity' in the underlying payment instruction. Submit to the receiving bank a board resolution authorising the share issuance, a share subscription agreement, certified incumbency and passports of investing shareholders, and a source-of-funds letter. Pre-clear the wire with treasury 48 hours in advance; upon landing, post funds to share capital and issue share certificates to satisfy the account-opening file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for operational disbursements to contractors, advertising networks, hosting providers, and app-store remittances; each message must identify invoice number, milestone, and project code. For larger procured hardware, licensing, or SDK purchases where a settlement instrument is required, an irrevocable documentary credit conforming to UCP 600 may be opened using the USD clearing rails (Fedwire/CHIPS). Low-value disbursements may use licensed payment APIs, but capital or escrow movements must remain on bank-to-bank covered wires.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla deliverable FX forwards (maturity up to 24 months) under an ISDA FX Annex with a licensed counterparty
European-style FX options in EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and AUD/USD

Cross-currency swaps for long-term USD-equivalent funding and non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted currencies, subject to bank credit limits and contractual legal enforceability under RMI law

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Franchise Tax Filing for Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before September 30 of each calendar year; no grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and non-payment trigger a 10% monetary penalty on the unpaid annual franchise tax; continued default for more than one year authorizes the Registrar to administratively strike off or dissolve the corporation

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No asset, revenue, or share-capital threshold triggers a mandatory audit for a non-resident private Business Corporation. A statutory audit is required only if the corporation is listed on a recognized exchange, shareholder owning at least 10% of voting rights requests an audit, or the Registrar of Corporations orders an audit in the public interest.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No financial statements are required to be filed with the Registrar. Management must maintain accounts that fairly present the financial position in accordance with an internationally accepted framework adopted by the directors, normally IFRS as issued by the IASB; IFRS for SMEs or US GAAP is acceptable for private, non-publicly-accountable entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual return must list current shareholders and directors as of the filing date. A share transfer must be approved by the board and recorded in the register of members before the transferee is recognized; any transfer during the year is confirmed to the registered agent. The Marshall Islands does not maintain a public UBO registry, but the licensed registered agent must collect, verify, and refresh beneficial-ownership information annually under RMI AML/CFT obligations.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and Share Transfer Ledger

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500–US$1,500 per annum for a non-resident Business Corporation using an RMI-licensed registered agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,500–US$10,000 per engagement for a small-to-medium private mobile utility software company; generally not incurred because no statutory audit is mandated

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Marshall Islands corporate income tax for non-resident business corporations; no tax on foreign-source income, no capital gains tax, no dividend withholding tax, no payroll tax for non-resident employees, and no business license tax for offshore entities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI corporate income tax return — non-resident business corporations are not required to file a CIT return; no portal designation applies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No filing obligation for non-resident corporations without income sourced from the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No tax return is required to be submitted to the RMI Internal Revenue Office for a non-resident business corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident business corporation must maintain records establishing non-resident status and the absence of RMI-source income, but no tax form needs to be filed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No tax return penalty can be assessed; however, any false declaration made in a voluntary filing may give rise to fraud penalties under the RMI Income Tax Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report Filing Statement under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act — filed through the RMI Registrar of Corporations online filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due before October 31 of each calendar year (unless otherwise specified in the corporation's registration file).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name and registration number; corporate status; registered office and registered agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The physical address of the registered office in Majuro must be stated. A non-resident corporation may not substitute a mailing address for the required registered agent address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers information, including any changes during the preceding year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be of any nationality and need not reside in the Marshall Islands. No tax residency or economic substance determination is made based on this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, including a shareholder list if required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not subject to Marshall Islands tax on distributions and are not required to hold a local bank account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the statutory deadline incurs a late filing fee of USD 100; continued non-compliance may result in administrative dissolution and loss of the corporate veil.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has not concluded any double taxation agreement (DTA) with any jurisdiction. DTA relief is therefore unavailable; no TRC submission or treaty claim is required. Dividends and distributions paid by a non-resident business corporation to non-resident shareholders may be repatriated free of any Marshall Islands withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate for cross-border royalties and interest is 0%. No treaty limitation applies. Payments for software licensing, IP royalties, or intra-group debt interest derived by the mobile utility app operating entity are not subject to any Marshall Islands deduction at source.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — the Marshall Islands does not impose transfer-pricing documentation requirements. No local currency threshold exists for Master File, Local File, or Country-by-Country Reporting obligations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019 imposes substance requirements only on entities carrying on 'relevant activities' enumerated in the Act. Development, distribution, or operation of a mobile utility app is not a relevant activity. Therefore a non-resident business corporation engaged solely in mobile app commerce generally has no Marshall Islands economic substance obligation. If the same entity also carries on a relevant activity such as intellectual property holding or intra-group financing, an economic substance self-assessment and a registered notification would be required.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Representing in the annual report or through a sham corporate structure that all income is foreign-source while in fact the corporation carries on business, derives RMI-source income, or maintains a permanent establishment in the Marshall Islands.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties, reassessment of back taxes plus interest, and criminal fines under the RMI Income Tax Act; repeated or willful misconduct may also trigger administrative dissolution and referral for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise false statements may be held personally liable for restitution of taxes; courts may pierce the corporate veil and issue travel bans and asset freezing orders in connection with criminal tax proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Forming a non-resident business corporation with no physical office, no employees, no records, and no genuine business activity solely to maintain an offshore bank account or to channel app-store revenues away from legitimate local tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Registrar may strike off or dissolve the corporation; the entity may be blacklisted as a shell company under FATF recommendations; ancillary fines may be imposed under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may become personally liable if the company is used as a mere instrument for fraud; foreign tax authorities may seek civil enforcement, while RMI courts may lift the veil, impose disqualification orders, and restrict international travel.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the mobile utility app with no AML/KYC policies while enabling anonymous or high-volume micro-transactions through Apple IAP or Google Play Billing that are used to launder funds from third-party criminal activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with the RMI AML/CFT regime can result in fines of up to USD 100,000 per breach, suspension of the entity's registration, inclusion in a high-risk financial activity registry, and enhanced mandatory audits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers may be personally fined, disqualified, and imprisoned for up to five years for knowingly facilitating money laundering or terrorist financing; a travel ban is routinely imposed during the investigation and trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Report / Veil Piercing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting the annual report and annual fee for more than one year while continuing to transact business, sign contracts, or hold assets in the name of the corporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Statutory late penalty of USD 100; after two consecutive years of non-filing the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation. Dissolved company assets may be treated as bona vacantia and vested in the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading after dissolution become jointly and severally liable for all debts and obligations incurred in the corporate name; the protection of limited liability is removed and the corporate veil is automatically pierced.
